data: DocAI  –  Offline  Multi-Agent  RAG  Pipeline  for  Internal  Document  Intelligence  is
designed to process and query large internal documents, including HR manuals, policy
documents, and SOPs, entirely offline. The system identifies the need for secure, fast, and
accurate document retrieval while preserving data privacy. It applies retrieval-augmented
generation  techniques  to  enhance  efficiency  and  relevance  in  responses.  A  thorough
survey of modern web, backend, AI, and storage technologies was conducted to evaluate
their  suitability  for  speed,  modularity,  and  offline  capability.  This  analysis  involved
comparing frameworks and tools to determine the most effective options. The resulting
tech stack was chosen to ensure scalability, maintainability, and high performance in real-
